title: Vera Rubin hardware reference database
basis: MEASURED on Rhea (runs/HW/hw1-hw3) + local ptxas 13.4 + CuTe DSL 4.8.0 source + internal docs (private hwdb; internal numbers not reproduced here)
gap_analysis: hwdb v1.11. die-locality-howto.md is complete and verified on Rhea (hw6-hw12): rules section 0b plus measured tables (placement, SM map, claim patterns, TMA issue capacity, load forms, gathers, writes, graph capture, torch LocalizedAllocator). Key measured facts: die-local read is about 1.41x striped. Fine 2 MiB mixed placement is free, but only with a die-matched claim. The per-die SM split varies by part (106/106, 108/104, 102/110). A TMA issuing thread completes about one ring stage per 0.37 us, so a single producer moving 16 KiB stages is capped near 0.6x of die-local for any placement; fix with 2 or more producer warps (distinct warp_id%4) or 32 KiB or larger stages. The NVFP4 MegaMoE tile streams at about 93% of die-local, while the MXFP4 K128 tile is capped near half. 256-bit LDG is the best register-path load (about 195 GB/s per SM). cp.async 16 B is slow (do not use for streaming). Row gathers: warp loads or gather4 from 16 warps are fast; per-row 1D bulk is not. Writes get no locality gain; in-place read-modify-write gains 1.22x; bulk reduce-add into global runs at about half the write rate. 2-CTA M256 MMA reaches about 95% of the double-K peak only at N256 (about 2/3 at N128). TMEM ld is about 800 B/clk/SM when batched. hw13/14 (v1.11): TMA producer subpartition placement <=4% (issuer count matters); multicast free but cross-CTA slot handshake on the issue path halves a ring; tcgen05.mma from 2 warps legal, one in-order pipe, commit waits for all queued MMAs, ~300-400 clk per commit->wait->issue edge.
inefficiencies: No Nsight Compute/Systems in the K3.1 image: counter-based root-causing (bytes, tensor pipe utilisation) is unavailable to every workstream unless a host install is mounted (flagged to INFRA in briefs/INFRA.md)
Counted TMA stores, early A-buffer release MMA flag and TMA L2 management ops exist in hardware/ptxas internals but have no public PTX spelling in CUDA 13.4
rubin_features: tcgen05 double-K block-scaled and FP8 MMA (sm_107a)
TMA gather4, address-override TMA ops, bulk multicast copy/reduce, async release multicast stores
locality domains: die-local VMM allocation, green contexts per die, cross-die L2 caching
